messages:
incident-bot: Postmortem for INC-2026-62 is published: https://redwood.internal/pm/INC-2026-62. Action items: status page blurb, short timeline, RCA sharing policy, recurring-pattern analysis.

nina_comms: I can write the customer note. We need a single-paragraph blurb for the status page and a 2-bullet timeline. No technical jargon.

omar_sre: Draft blurb: "Between 09:10 and 09:25 UTC we observed increased server errors that affected API requests. The issue was resolved by routing traffic and scaling capacity; normal service resumed. We have implemented changes to reduce recurrence and are monitoring." Thoughts?

tess_prod: Good. Change "scaling capacity" -> "bringing additional capacity online" and add "some customers may have seen intermittent failures." Keeps it customer-friendly.

nina_comms: Updated. Proposed timeline bullets:
- 09:10 — elevated error rate detected
- 09:25 — mitigation applied and service returned to normal

omar_sre: Agree. On RCA sharing: recommend we do NOT attach full internal RCA. Offer to provide a redacted technical report on request. Legal, can you confirm turnaround for redaction?

legal_team: We can perform redaction review within 48 hours. If a customer is high-touch, we can expedite. We'll need the RCA draft in the tracker.

sam_ops: Noting this looks similar to two prior incidents in the last 100 days. I'll open ticket RP-2026 to review recurring incidents and own follow-up. Owner: sam_ops, due in 6 days.

nina_comms: Owners and deadlines:
- Draft external note: nina_comms — due EOD tomorrow
- Tech sign-off: omar_sre — within 3 hours of draft
- Redaction review: legal_team — 48h after request
- Publish status page: tess_prod — once sign-off and redaction guidance confirmed
- Recurring-pattern ticket: sam_ops — RP-2026, due +6d

omar_sre: I'll sign off on technical wording. I'll also open an autoscaler PR and link it in RP-2026.

nina_comms: Customer-facing RCA line suggestion: "A redacted technical incident report is available on request after a brief review to remove operationally sensitive details. Contact support@redwood.com to request the report." OK?

tess_prod: OK. Nina, please post the draft in #customer-outreach and ping this thread when ready. I'll coordinate the status page publish window.

incident-bot: Reminder set for follow-up check in 72 hours (2390015600).
